assertions.subject: VSDs
assertions.quote: Approximately 85% to 90% of small isolated VSDs undergo spontaneous closure within the first year of life

assertions.subject: VSDs
assertions.quote: Patients with small, asymptomatic VSDs, in the absence of PAH, typically have an excellent prognosis without intervention

assertions.subject: Eisenmenger syndrome
assertions.quote: Historically, surgical intervention was the primary option, with heart-lung transplantation considered the ultimate solution

assertions.subject: VSDs
assertions.quote: Routine antibiotic prophylaxis for infective endocarditis in patients with unrepaired VSDs is no longer recommended

assertions.subject: infective endocarditis
assertions.quote: Endocarditis prophylaxis is primarily indicated for individuals with cyanotic congenital heart disease, a history of previous endocarditis episodes, those with prosthetic heart valves, or individuals who have undergone repair with prosthetic material
